author: andlo
name: MorseCode
description: Encodes/decodes text to and from Morse code, played as audible beeps. 'How do you say SOS in Morse' -> beeps out ... --- .... Niche but fully deterministic - a fixed character-to-signal lookup table, no ambiguity, appeals to the ham-radio/hobbyist crowd.
examples: how do you say SOS in morse code
